description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering leave request search results in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties and methods for setting and retrieving filter criteria such as statuses, employee numbers, subunit ID, leave type, and inclusion options, with some validation and default settings.

classes.name: LeaveRequestSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering leave request search results, including properties for statuses, employee numbers, subunit ID, leave type, and inclusion options, with validation and default sorting.

methods.name: getStatuses
methods.description: Returns the array of leave statuses used as filters.

methods.name: setStatuses
methods.description: Sets the leave statuses filter after validating against allowed statuses.

methods.name: getEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns the array of employee numbers filter.

methods.name: setEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets the array of employee numbers filter.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeId
methods.description: Returns the leave type ID filter.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeId
methods.description: Sets the leave type ID filter.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns the include employees filter option.

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets the include employees filter option.
